whitelist.title: This network lets through only whitelisted Russian sites
whitelist.body: Foreign servers are unreachable here. You need a server whose entry is in a Russian range

freeze.title: This network freezes transfers after 16 KB
freeze.body: Plain TCP servers at foreign hosting providers will hang: XHTTP works better

serverBlocked.title: Your server's IP address is blocked on this network
serverBlocked.body: Changing the port will not help: choose a server with another address

udpBlocked.title: QUIC and UDP are blocked on this network
udpBlocked.body: Hysteria2, TUIC and WireGuard will not work: the app prefers TCP servers

dohBlocked.title: Encrypted DNS is blocked on this network
dohBlocked.body: The app has switched to other resolvers on its own
